checks.title: Confirm retrospective and owners
checks.instructions: Name the incident, review owner, action/verification owner, decision audience and first question. This route starts after verified stability, not during active mitigation.

checks.title: Freeze the incident snapshot
checks.instructions: Record exact incident, service, environment, source revisions, recovery status, window and privacy scope. Probe the canonical incident and stability record; do not equate alert silence with closure.

checks.title: Agree on impact and timeline evidence
checks.instructions: Freeze numerator, denominator, affected scope, timezone and milestone rules. Match each material event to a dated source; keep absent telemetry and disputed cause explicit.

checks.title: Set blameless review and action policy
checks.instructions: Record reviewer, approval/revision path, sensitive-data and publication rules, action owner and due-date policy, accepted versus proposed state, and independent verification criteria.

checks.title: Bind two distinct Crew jobs
checks.instructions: Inspect and reuse or create Post-Incident Reviewer and Improvement Follow-Through Coordinator Crew IDs with selected skills, source scopes and separate output paths.

checks.title: Test incident, issue and verification reads
checks.instructions: Have the review Crew read an authorized incident, monitoring and recovery record; have follow-through read a current issue and independent verification source. Save exact IDs, timestamps, revisions and missing access.

checks.title: Validate review-to-action artifacts
checks.instructions: Save post-incident-review/v1 and run its blocking validator. Pass the exact artifact ID to follow-through, save incident-improvement-register/v1 and validate both. Demonstrate that a draft creates no issue and a closed issue alone is unverified.

checks.title: Review Builder proposal
checks.instructions: Show Crew reuse/creation, snapshot, source/privacy boundaries, review owner, artifact paths, validators, action authority and publication policy. Selection creates no issue, reminder or publication.

checks.title: Run one bounded incident case
checks.instructions: Use authorized stable incident evidence to reproduce impact, timeline and one proposed action. Review owner decision and a pending or verified action with source truth. Keep the route manual if evidence or validator is missing.

checks.title: Choose follow-up policy
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed paused action-check schedule with timezone, source freshness, cost, duplicate suppression and notifications. Completing setup never activates recurrence or external writes.
